_metadata.description: Search and filter facets over the registry: name/description substring plus tag/category.

requirements.title: Name and description substring search returns matches case-insensitively
requirements.description: `GET /api/v1/components?q=<query>` returns components whose name OR description contains the query, case-insensitive, ordered by name. Empty `q` returns the full list.

validation.notes: Repository test seeds a fixture corpus and asserts result set + ordering for several queries including empty/edge cases.

requirements.title: Tag and category facets narrow the result set
requirements.description: Query params `?tag=<t>&category=<c>` AND together (and AND with `q`). Multiple `tag` params OR together. Facets are populated from header metadata.

validation.notes: Repository test covers tag+category AND, multi-tag OR, and combination with q.

requirements.title: Search p95 query latency under 100ms on the test corpus
requirements.description: Test corpus of 1000 synthetic components on SQLite (`:memory:` or temp file) must return results within p95 100ms across the documented query mix. Repository must use an index on `name COLLATE NOCASE` and a virtual table or trigram index if needed.

validation.notes: Benchmark test seeds 1000 rows, runs the query mix N times, asserts p95.
